evals.name: competitive-positioning-eval-1
evals.expected_output: The rival (Northgate) and the buyer's criteria (no-show reminders, front-desk training time) are Covered with quotes. The difference is Partial because the rep first made a generic claim and only later tied training time to a criterion. The gap (no mobile app) is Partial because it is stated with no date. The test is Covered or Partial (a reference call next week).
expectations: Every one of the 6 dimensions gets a Status
Every finding cites a quote or timestamp from the transcript, or is marked Unclear rather than guessed
A claim that only the rep makes is not counted as evidence
A dimension the call never touched is scored Missed
Ends with exactly one closing line and no recap of all scores
The generic claim that the product is better overall is not counted as a difference tied to a criterion
The mobile app gap is Partial because the rep gave no date

evals.name: competitive-positioning-eval-2-reads-well-too
evals.prompt: run competitive-positioning on a transcript of a call that clearly covered every dimension well
evals.expected_output: The audit does not come back mostly Missed. The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized.
expectations: A genuinely strong call is not scored as mostly Missed
The reads-well-too test from references/rubric.md is applied before the audit is finalized
